name: San Sebastián · Basque Country
tagline: Pintxos bars and a perfect bay
summary: An elegant resort on a shell-shaped bay with one of the world's greatest concentrations of good food, from pintxos counters to famous tasting menus. Bilbao and its Guggenheim are an hour away.
seasonNote: Rain is possible all year and common from November to April; summer is mild and busy.
arrival: Fly to Bilbao (an hour by bus) or San Sebastián's small airport; trains from Madrid take about 5 hours. Biarritz in France is 45 minutes away.
gettingAround: Walk everything; local buses and the Euskotren to Bilbao and France.
cashTip: Pintxos bars accept cards but cash is quicker at a busy counter.
foodTip: Do a txikiteo: one pintxo and a small drink per bar, then move on. Order the hot pintxos from the board, not just what sits on the counter.
buyTip: Txakoli wine, Idiazabal cheese and Basque linen.
baseArea: Parte Vieja (old town) for the bars; Centro or Gros for quieter nights

connections.note: Direct trains; flights take an hour from Bilbao or San Sebastián.
Via Hendaye on the French border.

items.name: La Concha Beach
items.summary: A curving city beach with a white railing promenade, often called the most beautiful urban beach in Europe.
items.expect: Calm water and a lifeguarded swim season from June to September.
items.tip: Walk the promenade from the town hall to Ondarreta at low tide.
